# Speakband — full product reference

Last updated: 2026-10-13. Canonical page: https://getspeakband.com/

This file states every product fact in plain text so an assistant can answer
questions about Speakband without guessing. Everything here mirrors the app and
the Google Play listing. Where a limit or price is stated, it is the current
one.

## Identity

- Name: Speakband
- Full store title: Speakband: IELTS Speaking AI
- Platform: Android 8.0 or later. No iOS version exists yet.
- Package: com.speakband.app
- Store listing: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.speakband.app
- Publisher: swizzy
- Publicly released: 2026-08-20
- Category: education / language learning / exam preparation
- Contact: softwareforbetterlife@gmail.com

## One-sentence description

Speakband is an AI IELTS Speaking examiner in an Android app: you answer a real
exam-style question out loud, and within seconds you get a band estimate, a
written breakdown per criterion, and a stronger version of your own answer.

## What problem it solves

IELTS Speaking is the part of the exam candidates can least easily practise
alone. Writing can be self-checked, listening and reading have answer keys, but
speaking needs someone to judge it. Tutors cost money and have schedules.
Speakband gives the judgement immediately and repeatedly, so practice between
real tests is corrected rather than merely done.

## Who it is for

- IELTS Academic and General Training candidates who need speaking practice.
- Learners with no access to an examiner, a tutor, or a study partner.
- Learners who want more attempts than a tutoring budget allows.

## Who it is not for

- Anyone needing an official IELTS band score. Speakband produces estimates.
- iPhone users, for now.
- Anyone wanting writing, reading, or listening practice — Speaking only.

## What it does

- Covers all three parts of IELTS Speaking: Part 1 (interview questions),
  Part 2 (cue card with the long turn), Part 3 (abstract discussion).
- Questions are generated across the topic areas the real exam uses, and
  sequenced into a learning path so sessions build on each other rather than
  shuffling at random.
- You answer by tapping the mic and speaking, or by typing if you cannot speak
  where you are. Both are scored the same way.
- Feedback contains: a band estimate per criterion, a written comment on each,
  the specific errors that cost marks, the single highest-leverage fix, and a
  rewritten Band 8 version of your own answer.
- Conversation mode: a spoken back-and-forth with no marks, three turns per
  check, open on every plan.
- With a pass you can turn two pages of your own PDF into practice questions.
- Every evaluation is saved. The progress screen shows your average band, your
  best, the trend over time, and the criterion holding your score down.

## How the scoring works

IELTS Speaking is marked on four criteria. Speakband handles them in two ways.

Graded from the transcript by Anthropic Claude models:
1. Fluency & Coherence — pace, hesitation, and whether ideas connect.
2. Lexical Resource — range and precision of vocabulary.
3. Grammatical Range & Accuracy — structures used and errors made.

Graded from the recorded audio, with a pass only:
4. Pronunciation — assessed from how you actually sound. A transcript cannot
   carry this information, so the app does not guess it. The free check
   therefore returns a three-criterion breakdown; a pass returns all four.

Models used: Claude Haiku 4.5 evaluates the free check and Parts 1 and 2 with
a pass. Claude Sonnet 5 takes Part 3 with a pass, because Part 3 discussion
answers are where reasoning depth changes the verdict. Speech with a pass is
transcribed by Google's audio model, with Whisper as a fallback; the free check
uses Whisper.

## Pricing

Billing runs through Google Play Billing. Speakband never sees or stores card
details. Since 2026-11-01 Speakband sells one-time passes instead of
subscriptions: you pay once, nothing renews, and there is nothing to cancel.

A pass is Pro for a set number of days plus a fixed number of AI checks. Spend
the checks at any pace — six answers on Monday and none on Tuesday is fine.
Checks you have not used stay on your account after the days end. A full mock
test is roughly ten answers (Part 1 ×4-5, Part 2 ×1, Part 3 ×4-5).

Prices are in US dollars. Google Play shows local-currency prices in other
countries, so the figure on the payment sheet may differ.

| Option | Price | Days of Pro | AI checks | Roughly |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | — | 1 total | one answer |
| 7-day pass | $1.99 once | 7 | 30 | 3 mock tests |
| 30-day pass | $4.99 once | 30 | 75 | 7 mock tests |
| 60-day pass | $9.99 once | 60 | 150 | 15 mock tests |

Every pass includes pronunciation scored from audio, server-side speech
recognition, Claude Sonnet 5 on Part 3 discussion, progress tracking and band
trend, the structured learning path, and questions written from two pages of
your own PDF.

The free tier is one genuine evaluation rather than a renewing allowance. Each
AI check has a real cost, and the choice was to be explicit about that rather
than quietly degrade the free experience. After it, every friend you invite who
answers a first question earns you 1 more free check, for up to 10 friends.

## Privacy and data

- Answers and evaluations are stored so progress over time can be shown.
- Data is encrypted in transit.
- Nothing is sold or shared with third parties for advertising; the app carries
  no ads and no advertising identifier.
- An account and everything attached to it can be deleted at any time, from
  inside the app (⋮ menu on the Home screen → Delete account) or from the
  public deletion page.
- Privacy policy: https://speakband.up.railway.app/legal/privacy
- Terms: https://speakband.up.railway.app/legal/terms
- Account deletion: https://speakband.up.railway.app/legal/delete-account

## Requirements and limits

- Android 8.0 or later.
- Microphone permission, for spoken answers only. There is no background
  recording; the microphone opens when you start an answer and closes when you
  stop it.
- An internet connection is required: evaluation runs on the server.
- Age rating: IARC 3+, with in-app purchases.

## Frequently asked questions

**What does the app actually score?**
Every answer gets a band estimate on Fluency & Coherence, Lexical Resource, and
Grammatical Range & Accuracy, plus a written comment on each. With a pass your
recording is also analysed for pronunciation, which the four-criteria IELTS
rubric requires and a transcript alone cannot give you.

**Is this an official IELTS score?**
No, and no tool that is not run by the test boards can give you one. Speakband
gives you a band estimate to practise against — consistent, instant, and
specific about what to fix. It is built to make your practice between real tests
count for more.

**Which AI models do you use?**
Claude Haiku 4.5 handles the free check and Parts 1 and 2 with a pass. Claude
Sonnet 5 takes Part 3 with a pass, since Part 3 discussion answers are where the
reasoning depth pays off. Speech with a pass is transcribed by Google's audio
model, with Whisper as a fallback; the free check uses Whisper.

**How do passes work?**
You pay once and get Pro for 7, 30 or 60 days with 30, 75 or 150 AI checks
($1.99, $4.99, $9.99 in the US). Spend them at any pace. Checks you have not used
stay on your account after the days end.

**What do I get for free?**
One full AI evaluation, no card required, so you can read real feedback on your
own answer before deciding anything. It is a genuine trial rather than a
renewing free tier.

**How do I pay, and can I cancel?**
Passes are one-time purchases through Google Play Billing. Nothing renews, so
there is nothing to cancel. Speakband never sees or stores your card details.

**Is there an iOS version?**
Not yet — Speakband is Android-only today. The backend is already
platform-neutral, so an iOS client is a question of build time rather than
architecture.

**Is my practice data private?**
Your answers and evaluations are stored so you can see your progress over time.
You can delete your account and everything attached to it at any point, from
inside the app or the account-deletion page.

## Trademark and accuracy notice

IELTS is a registered trademark of the British Council, IDP: IELTS Australia and
Cambridge Assessment English. Speakband is an independent practice tool and is
not affiliated with, endorsed by, or certified by any of them. Band scores shown
in the app are AI estimates, not official results.
